heroLead: Claudia House gives Oregon's young people stable housing, life skills, and holistic support — so they can overcome obstacles and build self-sufficient futures.
heroImageAlt: A group of diverse, smiling young people sitting together
missionTitle: Increasing youth's behavioral, educational, and placement stability
missionBody: Named after a social worker and mother who welcomed teens of every background into her home, Claudia House continues her legacy through short-term emergent and longer-term care built on a balance of mind, body, and spirit.

stats.l: Core pillars: Housing, Employment, Education, Finance
Young adults served on their path to independence

pillars.title: Safe Housing
pillars.body: Short- and long-term Residential ILP placements in a warm, supportive home.

pillars.title: Employment
pillars.body: Job readiness, career exploration, and placement support.

pillars.title: Education
pillars.body: Personalized learning, tutoring, and trade & college pathways.

pillars.title: Financial Literacy
pillars.body: Budgeting, banking, and money management for lasting independence.

galleryBody: Comfortable bedrooms, shared living spaces, a garden, and walls full of encouragement — designed so every young person feels they belong.
galleryImageAlt: The welcoming front porch of Claudia House
quote: Do not apologize for who you are or where you are in life — just set your sights high.
